body: Mrs. Bennet announces that Netherfield Park has been rented by a wealthy young man. She wants her husband to visit Mr. Bingley so their daughters can meet him; Mr. Bennet answers her urgency with teasing evasions.
Mr. Bennet has already visited Bingley. He keeps that fact from his family until a teasing conversation about introductions reveals it, leaving them to plan a return visit and a dinner invitation.

Bingley's arrival at the assembly wins the neighborhood over, and he dances twice with Jane. Darcy's refusal to dance and his overheard dismissal of Elizabeth undo his favorable first impression. Back at Longbourn, Mrs. Bennet tells her husband about Jane's success and Darcy's affront.
